HelpCenterPage.q1: How do I create an account?
HelpCenterPage.a1: To create an account, click the 'Register' button on the homepage or login page. You will need to provide your name, a unique username, your email, and a password.
HelpCenterPage.a2: Currently, it is not possible to change your username (@username) after registration. Choose carefully! Your display name, however, can be changed at any time in your profile settings.
HelpCenterPage.q3: How do I delete my account?
HelpCenterPage.a3: You can delete your account in the 'Account' section within Settings. Remember that this action is permanent and all your data will be removed.

Fediverse.title: Fediverse
Fediverse.description: The Fediverse is a set of independent servers that talk to each other (Mastodon, Pleroma and others). When you turn it on, people there can follow you and receive the posts you choose to send.
Fediverse.platformOff: The Fediverse is not turned on in this network yet. When it is, you will be able to turn it on here, on your own.
Fediverse.loadErrorTitle: Could not load your Fediverse settings
Fediverse.beforeTitle: Before you turn it on, know what changes

before.scope: Only what you mark, post by post, as public, unlisted or followers-only is sent. Private messages, personal files and your account data are never sent.
before.past: Posts from before you turned it on are never sent, not even if you pause and resume later.
before.copies: Other servers keep a copy. If you edit or delete, we notify the servers, but we cannot guarantee that all of them comply.
before.control: You can pause or turn it off at any time, remove followers and block people or entire servers.
before.identity: Your Fediverse address becomes public and stays reserved for you: nobody else can use it, even if you turn it off.

Fediverse.verifyEmailDescription: To turn on the Fediverse, we need you to have confirmed that you own your email address.
Fediverse.confirmEnableTitle: Turn on the Fediverse for your account?
Fediverse.confirmEnableDescription: Your profile can be found and followed by people on other servers. Nothing of yours is sent until you choose the reach of a post. Copies that other servers keep are outside our control.
Fediverse.platformPausedTitle: The Fediverse is temporarily offline in this network
Fediverse.platformPausedDescription: Your posts keep working as usual. Nothing comes in or goes out until the administration turns it back on. Your choice is saved.
Fediverse.followersCount: {count, plural, =0 {No Fediverse followers yet.} one {# Fediverse follower.} other {# Fediverse followers.}}
Fediverse.pausedExplain: Paused: nothing new is sent or received. What you publish during the pause will not be sent later.
Fediverse.activeExplain: Active: posts you mark with a Fediverse reach are sent to the servers of the people who follow you.
Fediverse.confirmDisableDescription: We notify the servers of the people who followed you that your account left the Fediverse, and we remove those followers. Copies already kept by other servers may continue to exist: we cannot guarantee that all of them delete. Your address stays reserved for you.

reach.menuDescription: By default the post stays here only. You choose, post by post. After publishing, the reach does not change.

followers.description: Only your Fediverse followers receive it. Servers that do not respect the protocol may show more than they should.
